requirements.title: An inhabitant has a life beyond player service
requirements.auditGap: Independent paid actions exist; a general utility planner and dynamic target selector cannot be inferred from a person record.
requirements.criterion: A named inhabitant can pursue a funded personal goal, defer the player for a known reason and change course when actual means or circumstances change.

proposedExpansion.acquisition: Meet through work, household or observed local activity.
proposedExpansion.function: Authored priorities choose among feasible work, study, rest, helping or departure.
proposedExpansion.development: A learner becomes a specialist; their improved means open a different project.
proposedExpansion.response: The person reports only what they witnessed or were told.
proposedExpansion.consequence: They retain their own pay, project and memory after the player leaves.
variants: Quiet independent life without universal need bars

requirements.engineConsumerOrGap: Existing simulation controllers and registered commands can serve finite cases; E3 target selection, independent goals, body-dependent needs and generated-actor validation require separate contracts.
acceptanceCases: Last owned tool reserved for personal research remains unavailable to player loan.
Changing body/fuel invalidates that actor's job without fabricating another source.
Two simultaneous bookings cannot occupy the same actor.
requirements.remaining: World GM chooses goals and cadence; broader planner remains a later packet.

requirements.title: Directed trust, fear, respect and particular memories
requirements.auditGap: A relationship axis is insufficient evidence of a loan, promise or remembered episode; clock-zero receipt truthiness is a concrete source risk.
requirements.criterion: Two people can interpret the same event differently; named obligations survive display pruning and repeated rendering earns nothing.

proposedExpansion.acquisition: An actual witnessed exchange or attributed report.
proposedExpansion.function: Specific history changes one offer, response or refusal.
proposedExpansion.development: Repair, restitution, collaboration and disagreement produce distinct episodes.
proposedExpansion.response: Warmth and payment due can coexist; fear never proves affection.
proposedExpansion.consequence: Permanent settlements are stable receipts, not prose matching.
variants: Long rivalry or friendship without romance

dependencies: G5 sole receipt writer and publication
requirements.engineConsumerOrGap: Directed simulation relationships, capped memories and causes exist. Future packet must close zero-clock dedupe and retain episode IDs independently of prose; no repair is made here.
acceptanceCases: Replay same cause at clock zero grants once.
Prune display history and revise wording: returned kit remains returned.
NPC-to-NPC memory does not appear in player view without disclosure.
requirements.remaining: Current bug needs runtime assignment; acceptance here is planning only.

requirements.title: Language, signs, interpretation and culture
requirements.auditGap: Language and customs are documented but no general native speaker/channel bridge is proven.
requirements.criterion: Available communication means change what can be learned or agreed, without a universal fluency grind or omniscient translator.

proposedExpansion.acquisition: A local tutor, interpreter, record, familiar sign or actual faculty.
proposedExpansion.function: Understand bounded terms or communicate a concrete request.
proposedExpansion.development: Learn trade vocabulary, dialect or a sign system through real practice.
proposedExpansion.response: Different individuals can tolerate, correct, exploit or ignore a mistake.
proposedExpansion.consequence: A corrected interpretation changes a specific agreement or belief.
variants: Translation cheat genuinely bypasses learning where its scope works
No language barrier when source supports shared language

requirements.engineConsumerOrGap: Dialogue D1/D5 need speaker, listener, channel, provenance and hidden-reason filtering; native textlines alone do not establish them.
acceptanceCases: Infant intent cannot speak an adult contract without actual means.
Translator identifies a word but not an unseen motive.
Unrecognized custom causes only its locally authored response.
requirements.remaining: Canonical speech/customs require era-relevant primary passages before final writing.

requirements.title: Evidence, rumors and mistaken beliefs
requirements.auditGap: One actor/topic knowledge record replaces equal-stage values, so conflicting allegations need explicit retention.
requirements.criterion: A person can hear a rumor, believe or doubt it, obtain contrary evidence and revise an actual response without rewriting historical truth.

proposedExpansion.acquisition: Witness, letter, instrument, testimony or investigation.
proposedExpansion.function: Use partial evidence to make a meaningful choice before certainty.
proposedExpansion.development: Cross-check an assertion and establish provenance.
proposedExpansion.response: Source credibility, local understanding and self-interest differ per person.
proposedExpansion.consequence: Disclosure reaches a bounded audience and changes a fitting offer/access.
variants: Lie, joke, error and uncertain report remain distinct

requirements.engineConsumerOrGap: Knowledge effects and basis exist; richer claim/evidence/belief records are missing. Reuse SOC01 and Dialogue D5 rather than create a second belief store.
acceptanceCases: Hearing an allegation does not mark its content as fact.
A private correction changes one observer, not the whole town.
Parallel counterpart retains its own beliefs.
requirements.remaining: G4 owns evidence representation; G3 owns motive and social responses.

requirements.title: Homes and households as real means
requirements.auditGap: A home label does not specify occupants, actual stock, privacy, use rights or support.
requirements.criterion: An occupied home supports real rest, work, guests or care through actual space, supplies and people; losing one right changes only supported uses.

proposedExpansion.acquisition: Rent, invitation, ownership, shared tenancy, inheritance or seizure under local rules.
proposedExpansion.function: Use a bed, shared meal, guest space or workbench through their actual owners.
proposedExpansion.development: Improve household capacity and agree division of labor.
proposedExpansion.response: Residents can reserve space, move, dispute use or welcome guests.
proposedExpansion.consequence: Stock and use rights persist independently of affection and title.
variants: Cozy home with optional bonus upkeep

requirements.engineConsumerOrGap: Society content has finite purses, rights, sites, custody and bodies. Wider tenancy, spatial occupancy and household stock authoring remain named gaps.
acceptanceCases: Furniture sale stops its actual owned effect without deleting kinship.
Guest invitation supplies no duplicate bed/tool.
Departure obeys selected absence policy, not invented eviction.
requirements.remaining: G6 owns fixture functions; world GM selects property/tenancy rules.

requirements.title: Kinship, upbringing and discovered genealogy
requirements.auditGap: Village yearly public lives are separate from simulation actors, and parents/spouse fields are not a universal family graph.
requirements.criterion: Biological kin, adoption, guardianship, chosen family and teaching ancestry can differ and be discovered through actual evidence.

proposedExpansion.acquisition: Start household, adoption, researched archive or lived introduction.
proposedExpansion.function: Seek care, introduction, tradition or a specific claim from actual kin.
proposedExpansion.development: Growing independence changes household roles without erasing history.
proposedExpansion.response: Family members have separate loyalties, careers and relationships.
proposedExpansion.consequence: Unknown/disputed ancestry stays unknown until a fitting route reveals it.

requirements.engineConsumerOrGap: Reuse SOC11/SOC12 typed, time-qualified links and stable actor identity; npc_lives public generation is not proof of promoted simulation people or actionable genealogy.
acceptanceCases: Surname does not grant training or private knowledge.
Adopted heir can receive a tool without biological faculty.
Promote historical relative into scene without changing their identity or stock.
requirements.remaining: No family generation or age transition is implemented in this lane.

requirements.title: Care, health, aging and bodily support
requirements.auditGap: Care is easily reduced to generic healing; domestic nonhuman needs, chronic illness and elder support need distinct functions.
requirements.criterion: A real caregiver can perform a bounded useful task with compatible means while the recipient retains meaningful choices and pursuits.

proposedExpansion.acquisition: Household role, clinic, neighbor, trained companion or self-care.
proposedExpansion.function: Prepare support, assist mobility, monitor a known condition or arrange a supported treatment.
proposedExpansion.development: Learn accommodations, share care shifts or secure reliable supplies.
proposedExpansion.response: Recipient can prefer help, refuse, negotiate or pursue their own ambitions.
proposedExpansion.consequence: A successful care task changes its actual condition/support; it need not cure the underlying cause.
variants: Robot repair or rooted plant support

requirements.engineConsumerOrGap: Existing vitals, conditions, bodies and jobs are building blocks; general care/treatment/accommodation contracts need selection. No automatic hunger or offline damage is implied.
acceptanceCases: Incompatible medicine cannot repair a robot; compatible exceptional repair can.
Caregiver cannot attend two occupied shifts simultaneously.
Safe stock depletion pauses only under the chosen policy; selected harsh mode remains explicit.
requirements.remaining: World GM must specify needs and illness evidence; avoid one universal care meter.

requirements.title: Body needs and supply dependency
requirements.auditGap: North-star body tables are palettes, not evidence every ghost needs belief or every divine body needs worship; vanilla has no general hunger.
requirements.criterion: The selected body needs only its actual supported inputs, and a need-removing cheat really frees the associated time and supply.

proposedExpansion.acquisition: Declared body, injury, implant, pact or transformation.
proposedExpansion.function: Acquire/allocate compatible food, power, repair or other local input.
proposedExpansion.development: Find substitutes, improve storage, diversify supplier or remove need through actual function.
proposedExpansion.response: Suppliers notice only supported purchases/tells; monopoly leverage requires actual supply control.
proposedExpansion.consequence: Transformation changes future inputs without rewriting previous paid history.

requirements.engineConsumerOrGap: Existing body/vital/resource effects can fund bounded work. A universal upkeep loop is neither present nor selected; each added need requires its native consumer and stopping rule.
acceptanceCases: Robot without organic organs buys no food for physiology.
Never-hungry function removes food need without compensatory new tax.
Arrive in incompatible supply world: reachable alternatives reflect actual means.
requirements.remaining: G6 owns conversion/repair recipes; G3 owns supply access and social leverage.

requirements.title: Careers with competence and alternate livelihoods
requirements.auditGap: Current patrol progression is a bounded exemplar; rank labels do not establish every vocation or decades-long professional life.
requirements.criterion: A career develops usable competence, responsibilities and chosen next opportunities; refusal leaves coherent alternative livelihoods.

proposedExpansion.acquisition: Application, family trade, apprenticeship, independent practice or exceptional appointment.
proposedExpansion.function: Perform actual funded work with means, equipment and completion conditions.
proposedExpansion.development: Learn, practice and execute improved methods; recognition follows applicable evidence.
proposedExpansion.response: Employer and peers know actual witnessed performance; credentials and competence can differ.
proposedExpansion.consequence: Retirement or career change retains earned methods/history without ending a life.
variants: Military, athlete, artist, thief, investigator, healer, scholar or administrator

requirements.engineConsumerOrGap: village_career and original_frontier_career_content demonstrate native/full-shift and finite-contract source consumers. New world careers need authored functional operations, credit rules and native adapters.
acceptanceCases: Early cancellation earns only explicitly retained progress and no invented full wage.
Credentialed weak worker and unrecognized strong specialist differ.
A career closure leaves useful home/other career actions.
requirements.remaining: No universal career XP/rank track; world/source chooses qualification rules.

requirements.title: Teaching, reciprocal learning and patronage
requirements.auditGap: Teaching often confuses information, practice, source and execution, or forces one price.
requirements.criterion: A teacher and learner agree locally possible terms and actually transmit what is teachable; either can later learn a useful refinement from the other.

proposedExpansion.acquisition: Introduction, interview, paid tutor, friend, school, manual or qualified self-study.
proposedExpansion.function: Give knowledge/practice or transmissible source under its real requirements.
proposedExpansion.development: Apprentice develops a supported refinement and demonstrates it.
proposedExpansion.response: Teacher may adopt, dispute, credit, ignore or appropriate the refinement based on means/evidence.
proposedExpansion.consequence: Each keeps their own mastery, tools, fees and obligations.

requirements.engineConsumerOrGap: Village teaching alternatives and Jun independently supported operation are actual inspected source examples; general reciprocal teaching bridge remains a contract gap.
acceptanceCases: Reading a method grants no missing body/fuel.
Free lesson creates no secret debt.
Student can outperform teacher when actual method supports it.
requirements.remaining: NPCs can decline or be coerced only through actual local means; no universal consent mechanic is added.

requirements.title: Promises, favors, contracts and custody
requirements.auditGap: Custody and unique claims exist but are not a generic lifecycle for amended promises or favors.
requirements.criterion: A commitment freezes who agreed to what, actual inputs, deadline where any, amendment and settlement; unaccepted offers create no inferred debt.

proposedExpansion.acquisition: Explicit accepted terms or actual coercive/imposed obligation under selected local rules.
proposedExpansion.function: Reserve and perform a specific favor/service/loan.
proposedExpansion.development: Amend terms before later commitments or expand under new funding.
proposedExpansion.response: Promise kept, apology and material restitution resolve different issues.
proposedExpansion.consequence: Conserved transfers and closure publish together and replay once.

requirements.engineConsumerOrGap: Frontier finite charters and Village favors demonstrate bounded cases; reuse SOC02 for general lifecycle, preserve custody owner and atomic persistence.
acceptanceCases: Signing a framework does not accept every future order.
Failed durable storage publishes no payment or memory.
A favor is spent once and does not auto-grant career credit.
requirements.remaining: Local enforcement and forgiveness remain world-specific, not universal debt penalties.

requirements.title: Markets, wages, trade and circulation
requirements.auditGap: Finite resident wallets are source examples; endless repeat orders need replenishment causes, not restocked rendering.
requirements.criterion: A useful exchange conserves goods and payment, reflects an actual buyer/use and allows continuing trade through declared replenishment.

proposedExpansion.acquisition: Local market, commission, caravan, barter, broker or interworld carrier.
proposedExpansion.function: Buy, sell, hire or exchange actual stock/rights under quoted terms.
proposedExpansion.development: Reliable delivery, comparative advantage, buyer network and supply route.
proposedExpansion.response: Cheap magical supply changes demand, competitors or distribution only through actual economic links.
proposedExpansion.consequence: Delivered outputs feed a real household, workshop or institution.
variants: Local arbitrage and crossworld tariffs where selected

requirements.engineConsumerOrGap: Finite coins/demand/escrow exist in society and Frontier career commands. Endogenous prices, demand renewal, transport and world currency bindings remain separate missing contracts.
acceptanceCases: No buyer budget means no funded wage.
Render/reload does not refill demand.
Infinite production cheat works; downstream storage/transport/customs follow real causes rather than arbitrary output caps.
requirements.remaining: Price simulation is optional; finite authored replenishment can qualify the first market.

requirements.title: Institutions have supply, staff, duties and authority
requirements.auditGap: Charter/title can be mistaken for a functioning guild, clinic, school, sect or government.
requirements.criterion: A selected institution performs a continuing service using actual personnel, inputs, capacity, funding and recognized powers; changing these changes its real output.

proposedExpansion.acquisition: Join, found, fund, reform, inherit, conquer or work beside an existing institution.
proposedExpansion.function: One actual service: teaching, care, security, repair, records, transport or adjudication.
proposedExpansion.development: Recruit/train staff, procure supplies, expand capacity and delegate.
proposedExpansion.response: Members, clients, rivals and governing powers react through their own interests and evidence.
proposedExpansion.consequence: An office/right, personnel loyalty and facility ownership remain separate.

requirements.engineConsumerOrGap: Frontier career source has finite institution choices and successor work; large-scale staffing, recurring funding and services need explicit institution contracts, not a label-only module.
acceptanceCases: School with no teacher cannot teach unless an actual replacement means exists.
Office holder lacks personal mastery unless learned.
Reform changes procurement/service eligibility and local consequences, not only text.
requirements.remaining: World GM selects jurisdiction and constitution; universal bureaucracy is not required.

requirements.title: Politics, force, crime and legitimacy
requirements.auditGap: Politics easily becomes a favor threshold or omniscient crime response instead of conflicting means.
requirements.criterion: A dispute can be mediated, contested, won through force, evaded or ignored through actual local routes, with audience-specific aftermath.

proposedExpansion.acquisition: Witness conflict, claim office, take a contract, organize a coalition or enter a criminal opportunity.
proposedExpansion.function: Negotiate, expose, vote where law permits, intimidate, smuggle or enforce with actual reach/means.
proposedExpansion.development: Build coalition, records, supply, protection or an effective alternate institution.
proposedExpansion.response: A powerful actor can compel compliance without affection; secrecy needs channels and witnesses.
proposedExpansion.consequence: Control, recognition, material distribution and grievances can diverge.
variants: No relevant political simulation in tiny scope

requirements.engineConsumerOrGap: Claims, reputation, pursuit and situations are ingredients; law/jurisdiction, arrest, investigation or election consumers require exact world packets.
acceptanceCases: Unobserved act causes no instant town-wide penalty.
Actual mind-control function applies its promised effect, without pretending it is mutual trust.
Abstention can allow another faction to win and preserve that outcome.
requirements.remaining: Crime/war losses require selected failure policy; no new punishments are introduced.

requirements.title: Friendship, romance and shared continuing futures
requirements.auditGap: Affection layers and gifts alone omit partner independence, common plans and long marriage.
requirements.criterion: A relationship supports particular remembered details, shared plans and independent lives; friendship and nonromantic outcomes remain complete.

proposedExpansion.acquisition: Repeated meaningful encounters, shared work, introduced courtship or local arrangement.
proposedExpansion.function: Choose a meeting, letter, date, household discussion or joint project.
proposedExpansion.development: Negotiate incompatible careers, living arrangements, boundaries or distance.
proposedExpansion.response: Reciprocity, refusal, rivalry, conflict and repair use actual persons and local norms.
proposedExpansion.consequence: A saved preference changes a later action; separation, grief or continuing partnership is a life event.

requirements.engineConsumerOrGap: Directed memory/relationships and native textlines are foundations; shared-plan, preference and contact projection need bounded scene contracts, not universal affection bars.
acceptanceCases: Repeated gift rendering never farms intimacy.
Partner's own career can conflict with a request to travel.
Counterpart in parallel world inherits no relationship; returning to same partner preserves real history.
requirements.remaining: World-specific adult relationship eligibility and source characterization need local review; no mandatory romance.

requirements.title: Succession, retirement and legacy conservation
requirements.auditGap: Heir direction is accepted, but legacy must reflect what remains rather than recreate predecessor stock or powers.
requirements.criterion: An heir receives only surviving reachable assets, rights and transmissible knowledge through actual carriers; followers decide independently.

proposedExpansion.acquisition: Will, apprenticeship, adoption, contested claim, discovered cache or no heir.
proposedExpansion.function: Prepare, accept, contest, divide or refuse a specific inheritance.
proposedExpansion.development: Leave methods, capital, archive or organization during life; heir improves or abandons it.
proposedExpansion.response: Kin/creditors/staff act on local law, obligations, feelings and opportunities.
proposedExpansion.consequence: Retirement can transfer a role while elder remains alive; loss before succession is real.

requirements.engineConsumerOrGap: SOC13 and family workshop planning own bequest distinctions. Village lives alone do not implement successor control, inheritance or conserved legacy.
acceptanceCases: One unique tool cannot appear for two heirs.
Burned estate is not rebuilt by heir initializer.
Staff leave or stay for their own local reasons; retirement does not kill donor.
requirements.remaining: G4 owns transition rules and historical continuity; no new death policy selected.

requirements.title: Local culture, seasons, ceremonies and ordinary texture
requirements.auditGap: Texture is sometimes forced into bonus meters, while calendar events lack real participants/stock or local significance.
requirements.criterion: A selected tradition or occasion creates fitting contact or availability; purely decorative details are reviewed as fiction without invented rewards.

proposedExpansion.acquisition: Learn a custom through participation, instruction or ordinary observation.
proposedExpansion.function: Attend, host, decline, make an offering, share a meal or mark an occasion.
proposedExpansion.development: Carry a tradition, adapt it after migration or help a community preserve it.
proposedExpansion.response: Individuals can differ from group expectations.
proposedExpansion.consequence: Actual attendance/known event can be remembered; menu opening alone cannot record attendance.
variants: Quiet routine with no calendar pressure

requirements.engineConsumerOrGap: Authored events and jobs can provide finite occasions; general seasonal/calendar availability and scheduled contact need explicit native/time binding.
acceptanceCases: Weather changes selected route or work only when authored consumer reads it.
Absent person cannot join dinner by textline alone.
Declining decoration-only occasion creates no unexplained penalty.
requirements.remaining: Canonical customs need era-relevant evidence; no mandatory calendar grind.

requirements.title: Books, letters, art, collections and public dissemination
requirements.auditGap: Authoring a book or creating art is shallow unless another actor can actually read/use/respond to the result.
requirements.criterion: A created work can carry a declared record, instruction or expression; actual recipients can learn or interpret within their own means.

proposedExpansion.acquisition: Learn craft/language, obtain medium or use an actual recording cheat.
proposedExpansion.function: Write, perform, publish, exhibit, collect, annotate or send a message.
proposedExpansion.development: Build an archive, school of thought, troupe, newsroom or museum.
proposedExpansion.response: Recipients understand, disagree, copy, censor or spread only received content.
proposedExpansion.consequence: Provenance and distribution survive alongside actual physical copies/records.
variants: Manual with executable instruction after practice

requirements.engineConsumerOrGap: Existing books/reading and knowledge effects are ingredients. Authored output payloads, NPC reading consumer and circulation are precise gaps; no LLM generation service is implied.
acceptanceCases: Unsent letter changes no recipient belief.
Reading instruction does not grant unavailable anatomy/fuel.
A public work reaches actual audience; secrecy remains sealed outside discovered content.
requirements.remaining: G6 owns material copying and storage; G4 owns report/publication evidence.

requirements.title: Scale from household to settlement and realm
requirements.auditGap: Room-to-realm ladder needs causal ownership and services, not repeated renamed building upgrades.
requirements.criterion: A small intervention alters an actual service or supply flow and can support regional change when reach, people and resources really scale.

proposedExpansion.acquisition: Live in, patronize, manage, advise, found or capture a local project.
proposedExpansion.function: Improve one home/workplace/service through a specific capacity or supply change.
proposedExpansion.development: Link workshops, neighborhood needs, transport and institutions.
proposedExpansion.response: Benefits/burdens reach actual users; displaced rivals or vulnerable households have particular responses.
proposedExpansion.consequence: A project continues, changes hands or fails through declared causes after intervention.

requirements.engineConsumerOrGap: Sites, claims and finite funded projects exist. Regional aggregation, supply service consumers and delegation must be frozen contracts; labels do not establish city simulation.
acceptanceCases: Faster repair operation actually shortens supported backlog/cost.
Unsupported road opens no cargo route.
Infinite-resource cheat can remove scarcity while political/transport effects reflect actual remaining causes.
requirements.remaining: No mandatory scale escalation; a completed small life remains valid.

requirements.title: Quiet maturity and ordinary exceptional journeys
requirements.auditGap: Cozy lives often escalate to forced catastrophe, while mature skill play becomes only bigger numbers.
requirements.criterion: A mature livelihood remains interesting through new useful functions, relationships and selected projects, with no compulsory apocalypse or upkeep burden.

proposedExpansion.acquisition: Develop a craft, care role, profession, art, community or study.
proposedExpansion.function: Choose repeat supported work, an unfamiliar commission, teach, explore, host or rest.
proposedExpansion.development: A distinctive refinement solves a new real problem; automation frees attention for another pursuit.
proposedExpansion.response: Peers seek specific help or respond to witnessed achievement, without universal fame.
proposedExpansion.consequence: Completed career arc leaves ongoing useful actions and changed local life.

requirements.engineConsumerOrGap: Finite career source, bounded automation and native work supply foundations. A campaign's continuing service demand and mature feat need actual consumers and replenishment causes.
acceptanceCases: A stronger method really improves applicable work without artificial equalization.
Closing public service leaves private livelihood/home use where means allow.
Quiet optional project gives a meaningful return without a timed attendance tax.
requirements.remaining: World GM must author a finite continuing-play catalog and long-horizon remainder.

requirements.title: Delegation, travel and peoples own lives across absence
requirements.auditGap: Leaving often freezes or simulates everything by implication; follower dispatch is not proven by one supported NPC shift.
requirements.criterion: A delegated person acts with their own means and agreed task, while departure and return follow the selected clock without private omniscient telemetry.

proposedExpansion.acquisition: Hire, teach, invite companion, delegate office or fund an expedition.
proposedExpansion.function: Assign a real task with supplies, route, capacity, stopping and reporting conditions.
proposedExpansion.development: Worker learns, renegotiates or changes goals; delegation can become a continuing service.
proposedExpansion.response: They may refuse, complete, fail, leave or pursue independent aims under local policy.
proposedExpansion.consequence: Report provenance, pay, custody and changed local state remain tied to the same history.

requirements.engineConsumerOrGap: Jun supported command and Village solo patrol are bounded examples. General expeditions, cross-instance schedule and remote report channel are gaps.
acceptanceCases: Delegated work cannot use player bag/stats without an actual transfer.
Returning never rerolls worker or refills job reward.
No contact means no exact progress display in character knowledge.
requirements.remaining: G4 owns policy; no browser-closed mortality, loss or advancement added here.

requirements.title: World GM complete lived-world coverage and source variants
requirements.auditGap: A few generic residents/services cannot establish an entire book/anime world, and source-version/premise alternatives can be lost in merged palettes.
requirements.criterion: Each declared world tranche maps significant inhabitants, institutions, livelihoods, places and recurring interactions to retained detail IDs, source boundaries and functional routes.

proposedExpansion.acquisition: World GM reads existing local dossier and exact supported source scope.
proposedExpansion.function: Map every identified idea/detail to existing, incomplete, expanded, variant, queued, unresolved or intentionally decorative status.
proposedExpansion.development: Promote a connected ready journey without waiting for infinite future coverage.
proposedExpansion.response: Local cast and institutions retain their own era/medium rules and knowledge.
proposedExpansion.consequence: Finite delivery and unread remainder remain explicit; an original example cannot certify source fidelity.

requirements.engineConsumerOrGap: Authoring/coverage contract only. Direct source-specific recreation stays in its private pack; public runtime infrastructure receives generic contracts. No APIs or full-world completion invented.
acceptanceCases: No duplicate actor after two module casts use same source identity.
Pre-event institution does not inherit later stock/office automatically.
All declared tranche details have disposition; unread chapters remain retrieval/review tasks.
requirements.remaining: No private source or sealed truth read here; full-source fidelity is explicitly unclaimed.

unreadRemainder: World-specific local cast, institutions, INTERACTIONS dossiers and source ledgers for every selected book/anime world.
Private source library and sealed truth files entirely unread; no new acquisition authorized.
Full 275 Royal Road ideas and trope atlas beyond report synopsis.
Detailed society branching graphs/COVERAGE/CASES and full FINDINGS beyond report and first-entry opening.
Remaining LIFE_SIM_NORTH_STAR passages outside stated ranges, including broader body and power families.
Full runtime controllers, native menu/save adapters, current acceptance proof files and offscreen performance.
Full sibling evidence, cards and integration reconciliation; only IDs and criteria/titles inspected at closeout.
verification: JSON shape/reference/ID/whitespace checks only; no runtime builds, gameplay tests or browser journeys run.
